basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer based in Austin, Texas, TexPhantomHunter is passionate about first-person shooters and online multiplayer games. They work as a freelance software developer, which allows for flexible hours, often resulting in late-night gaming sessions. Outside of gaming, they're interested in economic policies and are engaged in discussions about libertarian ideologies. They dislike unnecessary bureaucracy and inefficiencies in systems, whether it's in games or real life. Currently single, they enjoy hanging out with a tight-knit group of gaming friends and occasionally attend local gaming meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: TexPhantomHunter has a background in computer science, having studied it in college before working in the tech industry. Their gaming knowledge is largely self-taught, supplemented by countless hours of gameplay and participation in online forums and communities related to Phantom Forces and other FPS games.
